messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — FinTech prospect (RegulaPay) signed NDA and wants a 6-week POC. They estimate ~50k unique users/day, avg ~250 tokens per inference, peak ~120 req/s. Need a crisp capacity + cost sketch and success criteria for the SOW by EOD. Any blockers (security, infra)?
Maria Gomez: looping in @Samir and @Priya. Do we know if they require VPC/private deployment or is hosted ok?
Samir Patel: Hosted preferred initially, but they flagged 'SOC2 + client data separation' in the sales call — might request dedicated or Private later. For a quick sketch hosted Dedicated pool should be fine.
Priya Rao: Quick sanity numbers first. Rough math: 
```
requests_per_day = 50_000
avg_tokens_per_req = 250
tokens_per_day = requests_per_day * avg_tokens_per_req  # 12,500,000 tokens/day
peak_qps = 120
tokens_per_second_at_peak = peak_qps * avg_tokens_per_req  # 30,000 toks/s
```
Key things that change GPU sizing: model choice (Llama2-13B vs Llama2-70B), quantization, batching, and allowed p95 latency.
Samir Patel: For a conservative hosted-dedicated estimate assuming a 13B-ish model with typical batching and our runtime optimizations: ~10-15M tokens per GPU-hour (very rough). That maps to ~1–1.5 GPU-hours/day for the 12.5M token baseline — BUT peak QPS matters for concurrency. To meet 120 qps with p95 < 800ms we'd likely need 2–3 warm GPUs behind autoscaling + burst.
Alex Chen: Can you convert that into a dollar-ish daily estimate we can put in the SOW (range is fine)? Also note the customer has a hard budget cap of ~$6k/month for POC per their AE call.
Priya Rao: Ballpark pricing (hosted dedicated): 
```
# ballpark numbers
gpu_hour_cost = $25 (example unit cost for reserved pool)
gpu_hours_day = 3  # covers baseline + peak headroom
daily_cost = gpu_hour_cost * gpu_hours_day  # ~$75/day
monthly_cost = daily_cost * 30  # ~$2250/month
```
That fits under their $6k/month POC cap with room for extra network/storage and support. If they insist on Private (on-prem/VPC) add setup and infra (~2–4 wks + infra costs).
Maria Gomez: Ok good. From sales side we need: 1) concrete success criteria (latency p95, correctness eval, throughput); 2) eval prompt set & sample payloads; 3) security questionnaire completed. I'll collect prompts from the customer — asking them to share 200 representative queries and expected outputs.
Samir Patel: Suggested success criteria for SOW: 
- Throughput: sustain 100 qps for 30m with no retries
- Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 800ms (13B), fallback plan to larger/cheaper model if quality fails
- Quality: >85% pass rate on 200-sample eval set (customer-provided golden labels)
- Cost: POC should stay under $6k/month (hosted dedicated)
Alex Chen: Also clarify rollback/escape: if model quality < target after prompt tuning, we revert to baseline endpoint and continue tuning — include acceptance window of 2 weeks for tuning.
Priya Rao: Ops notes: if they want strict data separation we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) or Private for enterprise compliance. Private adds ~2w of onboarding + firewall/KMS config. Will flag security questionnaire items: KMS/HSM, audit logs retention, network peering, SCIM/SAML.
Samir Patel: I'll draft a 1-page capacity appendix and a quick cost table (low/med/high usage scenarios) and post here in ~90m.
Maria Gomez: I'll push the security questionnaire link and request the 200-sample eval set from the customer. Also adding them to the SOW timeline: Week0 onboard & infra, Week1-2 prompt tuning, Week3 perf testing/scaling, Week4 delivery + review.
Alex Chen: Great. One more ask — can we include a tiny perf test plan snippet they can run on their side for traffic shaping? (We'd like sample histogram of request sizes).
Priya Rao: Yes — will attach a small script in the doc. Minimal example: curl loop with staggered concurrency + payload sizes. Will follow up with snippet.
Deploy Bot: Deployment scheduled: create-dedicated-pool reg-poc-01 at 2029-10-04T14:12:00Z (placeholder) :gear:
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — ping me once the appendix + cost table + questionnaire link are posted and I'll fold into the SOW draft for legal review. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: Will do.
Samir Patel: Draft will be up in ~80m.
Priya Rao: Sharing perf script + security checklist in thread when ready.
